As a member of the OPEX team, you will serve as a trusted business partner and advisor to the various [Company name masked] functional organizations. You will be accountable for a range of FP&A tasks — driving planning and forecasting processes with business partners, supporting monthly and quarterly accounting close and reporting for key stakeholders, managing the OPEX budget, and building financial models.
This role demands strong collaboration and communication with key partners, attention to detail, and a thoughtful approach to projects. We are looking for someone who can hit the ground running, has an inclination to teach and help others, and is willing to keep learning.
cond_0026.responsibilities:
Drive the annual planning and quarterly forecasting process with business partners; maintain planning calendars, user templates, and manage [Product name masked] inputs; deliver forecast-to-forecast variance bridges with explanations.

Partner with Finance Systems teams to build tools and reports that enable more streamlined forecasting, accurate reporting, and better insight; take ownership of system enhancements or new system implementations.
Identify and lead process improvement opportunities across FP&A, Accounting, and other partners to improve efficiency, reporting, and performance.
Execute ad hoc projects supporting key business partners within the teams you support.
Drive the compilation of financial projections supporting functional and strategic long-term planning.
cond_0026.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a similar field
At least 4 years of progressive experience in FP&A, accounting, consulting, or banking
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modeling and analysis skills, including the ability to analyze and summarize large data sets and make recommendations
General knowledge of GAAP accounting principles and accrual accounting, full P&L familiarity, and budget management exposure
Strong critical thinking and analytical skills — able to look at situations and data from multiple perspectives and synthesize what is useful for forecasting
Strong problem-solving skills — able to frame problems logically and identify a solution or path forward
Proven ability to work cross-functionally and communicate or present to people at all levels of the organization with varying levels of financial literacy

Knowledge of or experience with FP&A business partnering in a consumer electronics or other retail company
Experience working at a consumer product or manufacturing-focused multinational company
Familiarity with Google Workspace and collaboration tools

In this role you will be responsible for a variety of FP&A tasks including driving planning and forecasting processes with business partners, monthly and quarterly accounting close support and reporting for key stakeholders, OPEX budget management, and financial model building.
This position involves regular collaboration and communication with key partners, attention to detail, and the ability to take a thoughtful approach to projects. We are looking for a candidate who can jump right in, is comfortable helping and teaching others, and is willing to keep learning.

Work closely with Finance Systems teams to create tools and reports that allow for more streamlined forecasting, accurate reporting, and better insight; contribute to system enhancements or new system implementations
Identify and lead process improvement opportunities across FP&A, Accounting, and other partners to improve efficiency, reporting and performance
Ad hoc projects supporting key business partners within the teams you support
Partner with the business to compile financial projections supporting functional and strategic long term planning
cond_0195.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or similar field

Self-starter with right time first mentality, high integrity, intellectual curiosity, self-aware and humble attitude

cond_0241.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to support OPEX planning and reporting and drive process improvements in this space. As a member of the OPEX team, you will serve as a business partner and advisor to various functional organizations. The role covers a range of FP&A tasks including planning and forecasting, monthly and quarterly close support, OPEX budget management, and financial model building.
This position requires attention to detail, strong written and analytical skills, and a thoughtful approach to projects. We are looking for someone who can get up to speed quickly and is willing to both learn and help others.
cond_0241.responsibilities:
Coordinate with business partners on the annual planning and quarterly forecasting process; maintain planning calendars, user templates, and manage [Product name masked] inputs; produce forecast-to-forecast variance bridges with explanations
Work with the Accounting team at each month and quarter-end to ensure accurate accruals for key expense items and analyze results against forecast
Become the subject matter expert for OPEX variance explanations versus Plan and Forecast; prepare and document OPEX narratives for the teams you support; contribute to total company OPEX consolidations in coordination with Core FP&A
Coordinate with Finance Systems teams to build tools and reports that support more streamlined forecasting, accurate reporting, and clearer insight; contribute to system enhancements or new system implementations
Identify and lead process improvement opportunities across FP&A, Accounting, and other partners to improve efficiency, reporting, and performance
Ad hoc projects supporting key business partners within the teams you support
Compile financial projections to support functional and strategic long-term planning in coordination with the business
cond_0241.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a similar field
At least 4 years of progressive experience in FP&A, accounting, consulting, or banking
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modeling and analysis skills, including the ability to analyze and summarize large data sets and make recommendations
General knowledge of GAAP accounting principles and accrual accounting, full P&L familiarity, and budget management exposure
Strong critical thinking and analytical ability — able to look at data from multiple angles, synthesize information, and apply it to forecasting
Strong problem-solving skills — able to frame problems clearly and work through to a solution
Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate clearly with people at varying levels of financial literacy

Knowledge of or experience with FP&A business partnering in a consumer electronics or other retail company
Familiarity with Google Workspace and collaboration tools
Previous experience using [Product name masked] or a similar cloud forecasting tool, [Product name masked], and scalable dashboarding tools (e.g., [Product name masked], [Product name masked]); basic SQL knowledge
Experience working at a consumer product or manufacturing-focused multinational company
Self-starter with a right-first-time mindset, high integrity, intellectual curiosity, and a humble attitude
